name: codex_star
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE isolated rarity / upgrade star sprite for a medieval-fantasy unit codex, transparent PNG.
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE only. Look at the small warm gold five-point stars in the card headers. Generate only one new enlarged star icon, not the screen or card.
Subject: one regular upright five-point star, symmetrical around vertical center, crisp tips, balanced concave valleys, completely solid opaque interior. Simple muted warm antique-gold face, pale golden upper-left facets and slightly deeper ochre lower-right facets, very subtle restrained two-tone planar variation. Flat illustrative 2D icon, smooth anti-aliased high-resolution non-pixel contours. No strong metallic shine.
Composition: centered full star on a square canvas, approx 75 percent visual occupancy with transparent margin on all sides. Legible when shown at 28px in UI.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the star, perfectly clean empty space, no plate.
Avoid: pixel art, 3D rendering, realistic metal texture, thick bevel, extra stars, sparkle, glow, light rays, drop shadow, frame, badge, border ornament, text, number, watermark, checkerboard background.

qa.silhouette: 정면 오각별, 가운데 정렬, 사방 여백, 장식/문자/프레임 없음
